arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Chemerinsky argued the injunction violates First Amendment principles.
He claimed the order restricts non-parties and is overbroad.
Mr. Cole argued the side that brought the case targeted the opposing side for tribute.
He stated the side that brought the case admitted intent to engage in this conduct.
